decisions.reason: As a close adjacence to the core connectivity and voice offer, it is still too early to judge and the option value of keeping a low-incremental-cost enterprise conferencing service remains positive despite uncertain differentiation.

The reported adoption of the metropolitan data centre connection network is an early positive signal, and the product fits directly with the firm's infrastructure-heavy strategy and enterprise customer base.
Optical spectrum connectivity builds on the firm's owned fibre assets and future high-bandwidth direction, so with uncertainty still unresolved and strategic upside high it should be kept open.
A voice number ordering portal supports the firm's move toward software-defined, real-time provisioning and likely has modest carrying costs, making it sensible to keep while uptake becomes clearer.

Carrier pre-selection telephony is a legacy service with weak fit to the firm's forward direction in software-defined integrated infrastructure, so with no positive traction shown the option value appears low.

Direct voice network connection is close to the established enterprise communications business and can be maintained at limited incremental cost while management waits for clearer evidence of customer demand.
